dimensions.assessment: Directly involves TSA employees working at airport locations across various hub sizes and the TSA Administrator.
dimensions.evidence: Transportation Security Administration employees working at airport locations spend traveling between regular duty locations and airport parking lots and bus and transit stops.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a feasibility study and report rather than enacting the benefit itself.
dimensions.evidence: submit to... a study on the feasibility of treating as on-duty hours the time Transportation Security Administration employees... spend traveling

dimensions.assessment: The source notes that the study will estimate costs, but does not state specific spending amounts or appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: The estimated costs of treating as on-duty hours the time described in such paragraph

dimensions.assessment: Directs a federal agency to conduct a one-time administrative feasibility study and submit findings to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Administrator... shall submit... a study

dimensions.assessment: A one-time study requirement due within 270 days of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: The actual cost and operational feasibility of implementing the commuting benefits evaluated in the study.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the TSA to submit a study to Congress within 270 days assessing the feasibility and costs of treating employee transit time at airports as on-duty hours.
